messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look table of the **long‑weekend** holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday falls on a weekday that, together with the adjacent weekend days, gives you at least three consecutive days off.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Provinces/territories where it’s a statutory holiday | Long‑weekend? |
|-------------|---------|-----------------------------------------------------|---------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Manitoba | ✅ |
| **Mar 17** | St. Patrick’s Day | Newfoundland & Labrador, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, and a few others | ✅ |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | *All* provinces/territories | ✅ |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | *All* provinces/territories | ✅ |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | *All* provinces/territories | ✅ |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | *All* provinces/territories | ✅ |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | *All* provinces/territories | ✅ |
| **Dec 26** | Boxing Day | *All* provinces/territories | ✅ |

### Notes

| Holiday | 2023 Observation | Why it *doesn’t* count as a long weekend |
|---------|------------------|------------------------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Falls on a weekend – no extra day off |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Falls on a weekend – no extra day off |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Saturday) | Falls on a weekend – no extra day off |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - If you’re targeting users in specific provinces, filter the list by the “Provinces/territories” column.  
> - For a more granular view, you could add a “Weekend days” column showing the exact span of each long weekend (e.g., “Fri–Sun” for Good Friday, “Mon–Tue” for Boxing Day, etc.).

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data formatted differently (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need additional provincial holidays!
